title.en: Tell browsers to stay on HTTPS

detail.en: Without the header a returning visitor tries plain HTTP first, every time. One response header fixes that for a year.

forwardable.en: Or forward it to your developer — it reads the same either way.

body.en:
On {{domain}}, the HTTPS responses carry no Strict-Transport-Security header. Add one to every HTTPS response with a max-age of at least 63072000 and includeSubDomains, and make sure it is sent on error pages too.

When you are done: show me the change and how to confirm the header is present on https://{{domain}}/.
